## Area summaries

### streaming-teleport

Holtburger's portal tunnel is a faithful port of gmSmartBoxUI's state machine, but the protocol and gameplay around it are not. LoginComplete goes out the instant PlayerTeleport (or PlayerCreate) arrives. Retail sends it only at the end of the world fade-in, so today ACE's 'pink bubble' invulnerability drops while the player is still looking at the tunnel. The reveal gate is much thinner than retail's prefetch (destination LB terrain or cell only, with a hard 6 s cap). Retail's teleport hook never runs: autorun survives a portal. The indoor streaming gates treat seen-outside town interiors like sealed dungeons. Perf/unload hysteresis is deliberately not repeated (2026-10-04 5-perf.md).

### landdefs-terrain

The core LandDefs math and terrain sampling match the decomp: gid/lcoord conversion, adjust_to_outside, get_block_offset, the ConstructPolygons split hash (I swept all 2040x2040 global cells and the f64 threshold literal never flips a diagonal), triangle height/normal, find_terrain_poly, FloorZ, validate_walkable's +water_depth term and calc_water_depth. The gaps are in what the live faithful outdoor cell carries. Its block water type is hard-wired to NotWater (cur_landblock() is None), so retail's open-sea wall never fires. Its restriction_obj is hard-wired to 0, so housing barriers (indoor EnvCell restriction_obj and the outdoor yard RestrictionTables) are never enforced. The legacy heightfield fallback, used while terrain streams in or with ?faithfulOutdoor=off, has its own inverted water model. The adjust_to_outside stub and block-offset items from the 2026-10-04 collision doc are fixed (7100de40) and not repeated.

### books-journal

The contracts panel and the journal were rebuilt from the decomp on 2026-10-05 and still match it: FillProgressString status text, contact/location, the countdown from seconds-remaining, sort captions. The tracker doubles are now f64 in the protocol crate. The only contract deviation is the documented abandon confirm. The books are where the gaps are. The wasm book snapshot drops author_id / ignore_author / text_included, so the panel offers Edit, Save and Delete on pages retail makes read-only. ACE answers every modify with success=true, so a refused edit silently reverts. Text being typed is thrown away on close/cancel where retail's CloseCurPage saves it, and the inscribe flow is attached to the wrong panel with no Inscribable/scribe gate. The OpenAC journal is a local-file notebook, equivalent to holtburger's localStorage notes, so it produced no protocol finding.

### crafting

The client shows no chance math of its own, and neither does retail: the success chance comes from the server as a ConfirmationRequest. That request is the problem. Holtburger parks every GameEvent 0x0274 in a queue only the rynth bot reads, so a player with 'show crafting chance of success dialog' on can never finish a tinker or imbue. The same gap blocks fellowship invites, allegiance swears, augmentation/skill/attribute devices and emote yes/no quests. The salvage window skips retail's gmSalvageUI::IsItemSuitable gate (valid material, structure < 100, not Retained, the single-material option), and salvage results never reach chat in retail's wording. holtburger-world's predicted salvage preview is an ACE port, a client convenience with no retail counterpart, and was left alone. OpenAC's SalvageItemPolicy checks the whole top byte of the PWD bitfield (0xFF000000); retail checks only the Retained bit (BYTE3 & 1), so OpenAC is wrong there and should not be copied.
